items.title: Why Is Nasdaq (NDAQ) Supplying Surveillance Tech To A Prediction Markets Operator?
items.summary: Nasdaq (NasdaqGS:NDAQ) has entered a multi-year agreement to supply its market surveillance technology to prediction markets operator Kalshi. The partnership focuses on monitoring trading activity for potential insider trading and market manipulation on Kalshi's platforms. The deal extends Nasdaq's role as a technology and compliance infrastructure provider to newer types of financial markets.
